text:
Linh: Huge milestone alert  we just hit 5,000,000 requests this week 🎉🎉 — can we pause for 2 minutes and celebrate please?
Omar: WHOO!! Hell yes. The burst autoscale held like a champ. :muscle:
Casey: Confetti GIF incoming. Also shoutout to the tiny workaround that saved 200ms on cold start.
Jo: Is this an ARR milestone or usage? Either way, team deserves stickers + chaos. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Marisol: Usage milestone — product team saw a 32% uptick in active sessions. This will look great on the quarterly slide :).
SwagBot: ACTION: creating swag request form -> /forms/swagsurprise (please fill for remote distribution).
Ken: Can we do both cake in the office and a small grant to a local tech education nonprofit? Vote with reactions pls.
Linh: Love that. Proposal: cake + 1 charity donation. Also want a tiny "5M" enamel pin idea.
Omar: Pin idea: redwood tree icon + 5M, yes please. I'll sketch tonight.
Casey: Social post plan: quick montage + quote. I can draft a caption: "Serving 5M requests in week 1 post-launch. Thank you builders." Feedback?
Jo: Keep it short. Maybe add a shoutout: "Thanks to the runtime & SRE teams for the reliability wins"
Marisol: I'll coordinate with comms. Also remote folks—we'll ship a care package (snacks + sticker). SwagBot said the form will capture sizes.
Ken: Cake options: classic vanilla, blackout chocolate, vegan lemon. Put emoji for your vote. (reactions: :cake: x4, :chocolate_bar: x7, :lemon: x2)
Linh: Quick photo plan: meet at 4:10 in the kitchen for a minute, take a silly picture, remote folks drop a selfie into this thread and we stitch them together.
Omar: 4:10 works. I'll bring noisemakers.
Casey: Also leaving a tiny note: if you saw an hiccup during spike please ping #incidents so we can add to the postmortem backlog. For now, celebrate! :tada: (reactions: :tada: x15)
Marisol: Sending a calendar invite for 4:10 cake + montage shoot. Remote people, join the Zoom link in the invite.
Linh: Best team. Two minutes of basking, then back to iterating. Proud of y'all. 🍰🌲
SwagBot: swag dispatched: batch-001 -> domestic shipping queued. International shipping pending address confirmation.
